description: This PHP file defines the class 'DetailViewMetaParser', a parser utility for converting old HTML detail view templates (from SugarCRM versions prior to 5.0) into metadata definitions, along with related parsing methods and logic.

classes.name: DetailViewMetaParser
classes.description: A parser class that converts legacy HTML detail view files into metadata array structures for SuiteCRM, handling HTML parsing, regex processing, and panel merging functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, setting the view type to 'DetailView'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing function that reads an HTML file, extracts table-based detail view data, processes the HTML to handle variations and inconsistencies, and returns a metadata string representation of the view.
